implementation: Separate reviewed one-time/recurring Workspace reminder intents and immutable original configuration receipts.
Exact review cue/event revisions, explicit civil timezone/DST/end-date policy and per-device occurrence/attempt identities.
Fair bounded durable profile leases, consent/authority/expiry/quota fences and three attempts only for known rate refusals.
Auth-only RFC8291 encryption, RFC8292 VAPID and provider dispatch with original dedupe claims; unknown results never replay.
Four reviewed MCP tools share the browser API; lifecycle/disconnect/deletion and all ordinary deployment flags remain fail-closed.
Private sender readiness is distinct from the unchanged public subscription status schema.
retainedFailure: workspace-full.txt records589passing checks and a Miniflare D1 bridge fetch failure in the parallel run. The isolated exact disconnect control and serial full590baseline passed; after final readiness changes current-source full591 passed. No product assertion failure was inferred from the bridge transport error.
repairs: Pinned Workers crypto types required explicit key-pair/raw-key narrowing while retaining the standard runtime public ECDH field.

Workers rejects redirect:error before transport; manual plus explicit3xx refusal preserves no-redirect security and is checked by destination/count/result. Miniflare outbound Request.redirect metadata is normalized and is not used as the proof.
Legacy UTC spellings normalize for exact cue comparison; source task documents remain unchanged.
Explicit module extensions and fixture setup/command flags were corrected before valid controls.

timing.note: Controller sampling was not separately instrumented. Per-control tool walls are preserved without inventing prerequisite or cumulative controller time.

limitations: Local/synthetic fake-clock, actual D1/SDK and mocked provider evidence does not qualify physical iPhone/OS permission or actual delivery, hosted ChatGPT/Codex behavior, production deployment or live scheduler activation.
Dedicated device/setup and service-worker push/click UI remains the next selected unit; sender acceptance confirms backend dispatch behavior only.
HTTP201 establishes push-service acceptance; shown/read stay unknown. Cancellation cannot recall a message already handed off. No exactly-once delivery claim.
Live retained-history pages can change during progression. Canonical task archives exclude the separate reminder ledger; original config receipts retain exact intent.
Dispatch, vault/VAPID provisioning and contact activation remain explicitly off in ordinary profiles.
